# Project Requirement Document (PRD)

## 1. Project Overview
A comprehensive E-commerce platform built using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js), featuring a multi-role dashboard (Admin, Seller, Moderator, User), real-time chat, AI-driven recommendations, and loyalty programs.

## 2. Targeted Users
- **Customers (Users):** Browse products, purchase items, track orders, chat with sellers, and earn loyalty points.
- **Sellers:** Manage their own product listings, orders, and view sales analytics.
- **Moderators:** Review products and manage community-related content (reviews, chats).
- **Admins:** Full system control, including user management, category management, and overall platform analytics.

## 3. Key Features
- **User Authentication:** Email/Password and potentially Social Login (Firebase integration).
- **Product Management:** Search, filter, and detailed product views with reviews.
- **Shopping Cart & Checkout:** Secure payment processing (Stripe/PayPal integration).
- **Real-time Chat:** Communication between buyers and sellers/support using Socket.io.
- **AI Recommendations:** Personalized product suggestions for users.
- **Order Tracking:** Real-time updates on shipping and delivery status.
- **Loyalty Program:** Points-based system for rewards and discounts.
- **Multi-lingual Support:** Internationalization using i18next (English and Bengali).
- **Responsive Design:** Mobile-first approach using Tailwind CSS.
